---
title: "Animal physiology: proposed topics"
---

These units organise the planned animal half. They are outlines rather than
complete lessons or a confirmed teaching order.

## Organisation and diversity

Connect cells, tissues, organs and systems. Compare how different animals solve
physiological problems and distinguish regulation, acclimation and adaptation.

## Nutrition, energy and temperature

Relate feeding, digestion, fuel use and energy demand to thermal strategies
and environmental conditions.

## Exchange and circulation

Explain how gas exchange, ventilation, gas transport and circulation meet
whole-organism needs. Compare animals living in water and air.

## Water, ions and excretion

Explain osmotic challenges, transport, nitrogen disposal and kidney function
in different environments.

## Integration, movement and reproduction

Connect neural, sensory, muscle and endocrine function. Use feedback and
reproductive regulation to bring systems together.

Anatomy and normal histology accompany these topics. The exact specimens and
practical procedures will follow the established course material.
